newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT-Telebras still a strong buy.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT-Telebras still a strong buy.

text.p: -- Morgan Stanley said in a report it was maintaining a strong buy rating on Brazilian state-owned telecommunications firm Telebras and its year-end target price of $115.
-- Analyst Luiz Carvalho said Telebras remains the bank's favorite telecommunications stock in Latin America.
- "We consider it the cheapest way to play the Brazilian telecom sector, offering a combination of strong earnings' growth, a compelling valuation and positive regulatory momentum."
-- Carvalho said investors in Brazil's telecom sector, especially in Telebras, can profit considerably over the next 4-6 weeks. -- His assumption is based on the following three factors:
-- Prices paid by private investors for the Band B cellular concessions can reach very high values;
-- The Brazilian government may announce new tariffs for Telebras before the concessions are auctioned off;
-- The next rate adjustment could also put an end to the auto-financing program, which would be replaced by an "installation fee" mechanism that would increase sales and decrease dilution.
-- Telebras preferred was up 0.56 percent at 107.50 reais in late afternoon on the Sao Paulo bourse.
